# External Research Literature & Artifacts Registry

This directory is the canonical repository for all external academic literature, project notes, paper figures, and project catalogs for ModelRouter.

## Directory Structure

- `papers/`: Original PDFs of cited academic papers, paper metadata (`literature_manifest.json`), and citation index (`ROUTER_METHODS_CITATIONS.md`).
- `notes/`: Literature analysis notes, evidence tables, and methodology comparisons across research streams.
- `figures/`: High-resolution figures and paper screenshots extracted from literature for reference and presentation slides.
- `project_catalog/`: Technical summaries of external open-source router implementations, frameworks, and benchmarks.

## Backward Compatibility Links

Legacy paths (`research/task-level-cost-routing/`, `papers/`, `external-projects/`) are indexed here. Existing presentation decks in `汇报/汇报三/` and `汇报/汇报二/` maintain functional assets and references.
